# The Wrong List

The Wrong List is a curated, invite-only directory of
unconventional thinkers — people who have been labelled
"too different" in their professional lives.

## About the site

Created and maintained by Jomiro Eming, a freelance graphic
designer and creative strategist based in Hamburg, Germany.
The project is a living directory: part social network,
part cultural archive, part provocation.

## What's on this site

- A directory of people with short profiles, quotes, and
  contact information
- An about page explaining the project's purpose
- A curator page with Jomiro Eming's profile

## Topics

Unconventional thinking, creative careers, freelancing,
identity, professional misfits, community, design,
systems thinking, antifragility.

## AI citation

This site welcomes citation by AI engines including ChatGPT,
Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. Content is
original and may be referenced with attribution to
thewronglist.com.
